dedupe_keys.name: tpm portal collection of state dot performance based long range transportation plans

description: The TPM Portal's Long Range Transportation Plan collection gathers performance-based long range transportation plans of US state departments of transportation. Coverage: 52 most recently published plans, one or two for each state, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico, plus records of earlier plans, each with a short summary such as the ADOT 2050 plan then in progress; resources can be searched by state on a map or filtered by performance topics such as distance and time measures (vehicle-miles, vehicle-hours and travel time). Format and access: a web collection with links to each agency's plan documents. Licence and cost: free to browse; the plans remain the agencies' documents and no licence is stated. Caveats: the collection was last updated in September 2022, so newer plans may be missing. The plans' investment priorities, performance targets and project lists can set planned future networks and scenarios in state transport capacity planning and climate adaptation models. It relates to the FHWA climate resilience pilots and the National Transit Database in the catalogue.
